description: This file defines a command handler class 'SavingsAccountApplicationModificationCommandHandler' responsible for processing update commands for savings account applications within the Fineract project. It annotates the class to handle 'SAVINGSACCOUNT' entity updates, injects a service to perform the modification, and implements the processCommand method to delegate the update operation.

classes.name: SavingsAccountApplicationModificationCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class annotated to handle update commands for savings account applications, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles incoming JSON commands to modify savings account applications by delegating to the write platform service.
